correctness.rationale: The k-positive 010 frequency enumerator equals a finite product-coefficient Q_k(z)/(1-z)^2; each internal gap contributes j(t-j) per one and the exterior two gaps are free. The largest possible core length is k+2, with top coefficient one for k=1 and three for k>=2. Saturated sums give exact linearity at n>=k+1 and the nonzero correction at n=k. Independently counted every binary word for n=3..10 and frequencies 1..10 against the gap recursion. The infinite statement follows from the full bijection, not the finite sample.
